implements the GTK2 specific part of the context-menus.

static gint menu_single_apply (  GtkWidget *  item,
gpointer  data
)  [static]
 

wrapper for menu_selection_apply_one so it can be called by GTK.

this is called when a menu-entry pertaining to a single file (rather than a selection of files) is activated; see menu_add. in this case, NULL will be passed to menu_selected_do in lieu of an action_context.

Parameters:
item the menu-item that was selected. its "data" property will contain the anchor of the file's meta-data.
data the menu-action.
